caption:
🚀 एलन मस्क से 5000 साल आगे था भारत? रणबीर कपूर के इस बयान ने सोशल मीडिया पर तहलका मचा दिया है!

🎬 जल्द रिलीज होने वाली फिल्म Ramayana की स्टारकास्ट रणबीर कपूर, यश और डायरेक्टर Nitesh Tiwari एक खास इंटरव्यू में शामिल हुए।
✨ इंटरव्यू के दौरान जब DNEG स्टूडियो के VFX और पौराणिक हथियारों की बात हुई, तो रणबीर ने कहा कि Elon Musk ने अब जाकर flying car बनाई है, लेकिन भारत 5,000 साल पहले ही यह कर चुका था!
🛸 फिल्म के trailer में दिखा पुष्पक विमान पौराणिक कथाओं के अनुसार विश्वकर्मा जी द्वारा बनाया गया था, जिसे रावण ने कुबेर से छीना था।
🏎️ दूसरी तरफ Elon Musk की Tesla ने 15 October को Texas में उड़ने वाली कार का डेमो दिया, जिसकी production 2028 में शुरू होगी।
💥 Nitesh Tiwari के डायरेक्शन में बनी इस ग्रैंड फिल्म का पहला पार्ट 5 November को दिवाली पर रिलीज हो रहा है।

क्या आप भी रणबीर कपूर की इस बात से सहमत हैं? हमें comments में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Ranbir Kapoor says India had flying cars 5000 years ago as he compares Pushpaka Vimana in Ramayana to Elon Musk and Tesla's new invention
ctx.summary: Ranbir Kapoor stars as Lord Rama in the new adaptation of Ramayana, directed by Nitesh Tiwari. The film arrives in cinemas on November 5 during Diwali 2026.
ctx.text:
All eyes are on the release of Ramayana next week! Ahead of the release, the cast of the film are busy promoting the film. Ranbir Kapoor , Ravie Dubey, Rakul Preet Singh, Yash and director Nitesh Tiwari were part of a special interview with Star Talks, where they spoke about bringing the epic to screen.
During the chat, when the host shared how the weapons that were used during that time were so amazing and could beat modern creations. She also praised the VFX work done by Academy Award-winning studio DNEG (Double Negative) for the same. Nitesh said that it was great to reimagine those creations on screen. Ranbir added, “Elon Musk recently invented a flying car. I think India did it 5,000 years ago!”
Tesla unveils its long-delayed Roadster nearly a decade after first revealing a next-generation version of its original electric sports ​car, at a launch event in Waco, Texas, US, on October 15. During a demonstration event at SpaceX’s rocket development and testing facility in Texas, the electric supercar drove upside-down on a huge curved ramp, flipped, remained airborne for a few seconds, and then landed safely on the ground. "Well, it worked," Tesla CEO Elon Musk said after it successfully landed. The supercar will not be available for purchase immediately. Elon Musk said that the car will enter production in 2028.
Meanwhile, Yash said that it is beautiful to see this interpretation of Ramayana and how relatable this story is even today.
The Pushpaka Vimana is a mythical, self-moving aerial chariot or flying palace described in the Hindu epic the Ramayana. It was one of the visual elements featured in the trailer which stood out as a gigantic flying structure.
As per Hindu mythology, the Vimana (airborne palace) was created by Vishwakarma, the celestial architect, for Lord Brahma. He then gave the Vimana as a gift to Kubera, the God of wealth and half-brother of Ravana. However, Ravana stole the Pushpaka Vimana from Kubera after defeating him. In the epic, Pushpaka Vimana is described as a flying palace which can fly at the speed of thought and expand to accommodate any number of people.
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is a two-part cinematic adaptation of the ancient Indian epic. Ranbir Kapoor plays Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi portrays Sita, and Yash plays Ravana. The cast also includes Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. The film is produced by Namit Malhotra and Yash, with music by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. The first part releases in theatres on November 5, on the occasion of Diwali.
